in_hindi.name: साईस्री
in_hindi.long_meaning: सरस्वती (Goddess of Knowledge), लक्ष्मी (Goddess of Wealth)

in_marathi.name: Saisri
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Saisri हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Saisri is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Sri', which represents the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and fertility in Hindu mythology. This name is believed to bring fortune, success, and abundance to the bearer. It is a popular name among Hindus and is given to girls as a symbol of blessings from the gods for a prosperous and blessed life.
